links.outcome: Trial-to-trial output consistency and completeness of clinical summaries across repeated runs
links.effect: Accuracy and predictability were independent (r = -0.24, p = 0.56, N = 8). LAD occlusion appeared in only 22% of Llama 4 Scout summaries (Variance Ratio 7.46); Llama 4 Maverick VR 2.64.
links.quote: LAD occlusion, a critical clinical finding in STEMI cases, appears in only 22% of Llama 4 Scout summaries despite the model correctly identifying it when directly queried.

links.outcome: Over-refusal by safety filter on clinical summarization task
links.effect: Gemini Flash reached 16% accuracy due to over-refusal, and was flagged as needing safety filter reconfiguration.
links.quote: flag one model requiring safety filter reconfiguration (Gemini Flash, 16% accuracy due to over-refusal)

unlisted_practices: Two-dimensional predictability-by-accuracy evaluation using variance ratio across repeated trials as a minimum requirement for clinical AI assessment

screen.reason: Empirically tests multiple LLMs on a clinical summarization task across repeated runs to reveal trial-to-trial variance and stochastic incompleteness, proposing an evaluation framework but not testing a specific deployment safeguard/practice intervention.
